<!doctype html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=240,initial-scale=1">
<style>
html,body{width:240px;height:242px;margin:0;overflow:hidden;background:#b9a993}canvas{display:block;width:240px;height:242px}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';
import {RoundedBoxGeometry} from 'three/addons/geometries/RoundedBoxGeometry.js';

const scene=new THREE.Scene();
scene.background=new THREE.Color(0xbeb5a9);
const renderer=new THREE.WebGLRenderer({preserveDrawingBuffer:true});
renderer.setPixelRatio(1);
renderer.setSize(240,242,false);
renderer.shadowMap.enabled=true;
renderer.shadowMap.type=THREE.PCFSoftShadowMap;
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);
const ref=new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-2.4,2.4,2.42,-2.42,.1,50);
ref.position.set(0,3.12,9.5);
ref.lookAt(0,1.65,0);
const V=(x,y,z)=>new THREE.Vector3(x,y,z);
function group(p,name){
  const g=new THREE.Group();g.name=name;p.add(g);return g;
}
function material(color,roughness=.88){return new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color,roughness});}
function mesh(p,name,geometry,mat){
  const o=new THREE.Mesh(geometry,mat);o.name=name;p.add(o);
  o.castShadow=o.receiveShadow=true;return o;
}
const sphere=new THREE.SphereGeometry(1,40,30);
function oval(p,name,xyz,scale,mat){
  const o=mesh(p,name,sphere,mat);o.position.set(...xyz);o.scale.set(...scale);return o;
}
function box(p,name,pos,size,mat,r=0){
  const geom=r?new RoundedBoxGeometry(...size,3,r):new THREE.BoxGeometry(...size);
  const o=mesh(p,name,geom,mat);o.position.set(...pos);return o;
}
function stroke(p,name,pts,r,mat){
  const path=new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(pts.map(a=>V(...a)));
  return mesh(p,name,new THREE.TubeGeometry(path,24,r,10,false),mat);
}
function sweep(p,name,points,radii,mat,flat=1){
  const path=new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(points.map(a=>V(...a)));
  const verts=[],ids=[],uv=[],ns=36,na=28;
  for(let i=0;i<=ns;i++){
    const t=i/ns,c=path.getPoint(t),dir=path.getTangent(t).normalize();
    const u=V(0,0,1).cross(dir).normalize(),v=dir.clone().cross(u).normalize();
    const f=t*(radii.length-1),j=Math.min(Math.floor(f),radii.length-2);
    const rad=THREE.MathUtils.lerp(radii[j],radii[j+1],f-j);
    for(let k=0;k<=na;k++){
      const a=k/na*2*Math.PI;
      const q=c.clone().addScaledVector(u,Math.cos(a)*rad).addScaledVector(v,Math.sin(a)*rad*flat);
      verts.push(q.x,q.y,q.z);uv.push(k/na,t);
      if(i&&k){const b=i*(na+1)+k;ids.push(b-na-2,b,b-1,b-na-2,b-na-1,b);}
    }
  }
  const geom=new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  geom.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(verts,3));
  geom.setAttribute('uv',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(uv,2));geom.setIndex(ids);
  geom.computeVertexNormals();mat.side=THREE.DoubleSide;return mesh(p,name,geom,mat);
}
let seed=21403;
function random(){seed=(1664525*seed+1013904223)>>>0;return seed/4294967296;}
function grain(){
  const data=new Uint8Array(64*64*4);
  for(let i=0;i<data.length;i+=4){
    const n=Math.round(210+45*random());data.set([n,n,n,255],i);
  }
  const tex=new THREE.DataTexture(data,64,64);
  tex.wrapS=tex.wrapT=THREE.RepeatWrapping;tex.repeat.set(5,4);
  tex.magFilter=THREE.LinearFilter;tex.minFilter=THREE.LinearMipmapLinearFilter;
  tex.generateMipmaps=true;tex.needsUpdate=true;return tex;
}
const fleece=grain(),skin=material(0xffffff);
skin.vertexColors=true;skin.map=fleece;skin.bumpMap=fleece;skin.bumpScale=.013;
const gold=material(0xffb921);gold.map=fleece;gold.bumpMap=fleece;gold.bumpScale=.01;
const finger=material(0x65594c),eye=material(0x897965),pupil=material(0x211d1a,.7),lip=material(0x543619);
const yellow=new THREE.Color(0xffbd25),cream=new THREE.Color(0xffe5b4);
const characters=[],rigs=[];
function creature(name,x,z,height,lean,yaw){
  const root=group(scene,name);characters.push(root);root.position.set(x,-.13,z);root.rotation.y=yaw;
  const torso=group(root,'torso'),head=group(root,'head');
  const outline=[[0,.49,.43],[.05,.78,.61],[.17,.94,.73],[.30,.95,.74],
    [.43,.86,.69],[.56,.75,.62],[.68,.66,.55],[.78,.615,.525],
    [.86,.565,.48],[.93,.46,.40],[.978,.28,.26],[1,.002,.002]];
  const profile=new THREE.SplineCurve(outline.map(([t,w])=>new THREE.Vector2(t,w)));
  const depth=new THREE.SplineCurve(outline.map(([t,w,d])=>new THREE.Vector2(t,d)));
  function center(t){return lean*t*t*(3-2*t);}
  const pivot=V(center(.65),height*.65,0);
  head.position.copy(pivot);
  function surface(name,parent,start,end){
    const verts=[],colors=[],ids=[],uv=[],n=48,m=88;
    for(let i=0;i<=n;i++){
      const f=THREE.MathUtils.lerp(start,end,i/n);
      const a=profile.getPoint(f),b=depth.getPoint(f),t=a.x;
      for(let j=0;j<=m;j++){
        const theta=(j/m-.5)*Math.PI*2;
        const q=V(center(t)+Math.sin(theta)*a.y,t*height,Math.cos(theta)*b.y+.085*t*t);
        if(parent===head)q.sub(pivot);
        verts.push(q.x,q.y,q.z);uv.push(j/m,f);
        const dist=Math.hypot(theta/1.28,(t-.135)/.33);
        const col=yellow.clone().lerp(cream,1-THREE.MathUtils.smoothstep(dist,.94,1.02));
        colors.push(col.r,col.g,col.b);
        if(i&&j){const k=i*(m+1)+j;ids.push(k-m-2,k-m-1,k,k-m-2,k,k-1);}
      }
    }
    const g=new THREE.BufferGeometry();
    g.setAttribute('uv',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(uv,2));
    g.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(verts,3));
    g.setAttribute('color',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(colors,3));
    g.setIndex(ids);g.computeVertexNormals();return mesh(parent,name,g,skin);
  }
  const body=surface('body and pale breast',torso,0,7/11);
  surface('rounded crown',head,7/11,1);
  const eyes=group(head,'eyes'),left=name==='character-left';
  for(const sign of [-1,1]){
    const g=group(eyes,sign<0?'left eye':'right eye');
    g.position.set(center(.775)+sign*.385,height*.776+(left?-sign*.035:sign*.017),.48).sub(pivot);
    g.rotation.y=sign*.56;
    oval(g,'soft eye surround',[0,0,0],[.161,.179,.112],eye);
    oval(g,'dark pupil',[left?.032:-.029,-.026,.089],[.104,.119,.057],pupil);
  }
  const mouth=group(head,'mouth');
  mouth.position.set(center(.67),height*(left?.658:.676),.605).sub(pivot);
  if(left){
    stroke(mouth,'small smile',[[-.17,.035,-.024],[-.09,-.01,-.005],[.034,-.025,.001],[.13,.005,-.013]],.019,lip);
    oval(mouth,'mouth opening',[0,0,.001],[.17,.046,.029],material(0x342315));
  }else{
    const shape=new THREE.Shape();shape.moveTo(-.21,.035);shape.quadraticCurveTo(-.02,-.008,.195,.039);
    shape.quadraticCurveTo(.035,-.14,-.14,-.046);shape.quadraticCurveTo(-.198,-.018,-.21,.035);
    mesh(mouth,'open smile',new THREE.ShapeGeometry(shape,16),material(0x392718));
  }
  const pos=body.geometry.attributes.position;
  rigs.push({root,head,pivot,mouth,height,body,rest:pos.array.slice(),seam:height*outline[7][0]});
  return root;
}
const left=creature('character-left',-1.24,-.025,3.22,.20,.39);
const right=creature('character-right',1.43,-.29,3.38,-.75,-.72);
scene.updateMatrixWorld(true);
function arm(root,name,pts,radii){
  const g=group(root,name);
  const coords=pts.map(p=>root.worldToLocal(V(...p)).toArray());
  const o=sweep(g,'plush arm',coords,radii,gold,.95);
  return {o,rest:o.geometry.attributes.position.array.slice(),root};
}
function hand(root,name,center,angle,size,spread=.05){
  const g=group(root,name);
  g.position.copy(root.worldToLocal(V(...center)));g.rotation.y=-root.rotation.y;
  g.rotateZ(angle);g.scale.setScalar(size);
  oval(g,'palm',[0,0,0],[.20,.145,.112],finger);
  for(let i=0;i<4;i++){
    const x=(i-1.5)*.081,len=.16+.051*Math.sin((i+.5)*Math.PI/4),end=x+(i-1.5)*spread;
    sweep(g,'finger '+(i+1),[[x,-.038,.006],[x*.99,-.112,.04],[end,-len,.061],[end+.012,-len-.055,.054]],
      [.058,.064,.055,.009],finger,.89);
  }
  sweep(g,'thumb',[[-.117,.036,.01],[-.197,-.003,.054],[-.233,-.09,.078],[-.226,-.126,.076]],[.075,.073,.056,.01],finger);
  return g;
}
const writingArm=arm(left,'writing arm',[[-1.84,1.84,.11],[-2.02,1.46,.33],[-2.13,.91,.61],[-2.02,.47,.92],[-1.76,.34,1.14]],[.24,.29,.268,.227,.15]);
arm(left,'resting arm',[[-.63,1.73,-.02],[-.32,1.44,.21],[-.17,.99,.41],[-.18,.51,.63]],[.19,.225,.204,.14]);
hand(left,'resting hand',[-.18,.375,.69],.11,.77,.015);
const farArm=arm(right,'far arm',[[.95,2.17,-.39],[.59,2.04,-.28],[.18,1.86,-.14],[-.21,1.78,-.015],[-.45,1.94,.11]],[.24,.28,.24,.18,.116]);
const shoulderHand=hand(right,'hand on shoulder',[-.48,1.97,.13],-.67,.65,.014);
const reaching=arm(right,'reaching arm',[[1.66,2.15,.10],[1.64,1.76,.31],[1.39,1.36,.56],[.92,1.12,.77],[.34,1.00,.91],[-.15,.86,.95]],[.19,.35,.373,.33,.266,.178]);
const rubbingHand=hand(right,'hand on belly',[-.38,.81,.97],-1.30,1.03,.025);
const room=group(scene,'classroom');
box(room,'plaster wall',[0,2.6,-5.4],[22,9,.22],material(0xc2bab0));
box(room,'wall return',[-3.33,3,-5.16],[4.2,8,.28],material(0xb9a68d));
box(room,'chalkboard frame',[2.75,3.62,-5.03],[7.4,1.91,.18],material(0x51483b),.045);
box(room,'chalkboard',[2.75,3.66,-4.907],[7.24,1.78,.07],material(0x193333),.03);
box(room,'chalk rail',[2.75,2.71,-4.87],[7.53,.095,.22],material(0x695b49),.025);
const timber=material(0x865634),darkwood=material(0x51371f);
for(let i=-2;i<3;i++){
  const x=i*2.55+.44;
  box(room,'distant desk',[x,1.67,-3.75],[2.51,.13,.9],timber,.04);
  box(room,'desk apron',[x,1.47,-3.55],[2.43,.30,.12],darkwood);
  box(room,'chair back',[x+.39,1.23,-2.72],[1.04,.66,.13],timber,.08);
  box(room,'chair post',[x+.79,.65,-2.73],[.095,1.46,.095],darkwood);
}
const desk=group(scene,'foreground desks');
const wood=material(0xdca351),edge=material(0x996630);
box(desk,'left writing surface',[-1.44,-.033,1.42],[4.93,.17,3.48],wood,.045);
const rightDesk=group(desk,'neighboring desk');rightDesk.position.set(2.35,.075,1.06);rightDesk.rotation.y=-.14;
box(rightDesk,'right writing surface',[0,0,0],[2.66,.16,2.81],wood,.045);
box(rightDesk,'edge',[0,-.096,0],[2.62,.10,2.78],edge,.03);
const paper=material(0xfff4d9),pageEdges=material(0xd7c6a6),cover=material(0x6c5139);
function book(name,xyz,w,d,angle){
  const g=group(scene,name);g.position.set(...xyz);g.rotation.y=angle;
  box(g,'binding',[0,0,0],[2*w+.055,.055,d+.05],cover,.022);
  for(const side of [-1,1]){
    for(let layer=0;layer<4;layer++){
      const v=[],ix=[];
      for(let i=0;i<=20;i++){
        const u=i/20,x=side*(u*w+.004);
        const h=.033+.032*layer+.113*Math.sin(Math.PI*u)*Math.exp(-1.5*u)-.018*u;
        for(let j=0;j<2;j++)v.push(x,h+.012*(j-.5)*u,(j-.5)*d+(layer-2)*.006);
        if(i){const k=2*i;ix.push(k-2,k-1,k,k,k-1,k+1);}
      }
      const geo=new THREE.BufferGeometry();geo.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(v,3));geo.setIndex(ix);geo.computeVertexNormals();
      const m=layer===3?paper:pageEdges;m.side=THREE.DoubleSide;mesh(g,'leaf',geo,m);
    }
  }
}
book('open exercise book',[-.84,.097,1.91],1.49,1.68,.20);
book('second open book',[1.95,.19,1.11],.94,1.45,-.18);
const metal=material(0xb7aca0,.38),ink=material(0x3d3931);
function rod(p,name,a,b,r1,r2,mat){
  const start=V(...a),end=V(...b),vec=end.clone().sub(start);
  const o=mesh(p,name,new THREE.CylinderGeometry(r2,r1,vec.length(),14),mat);
  o.position.copy(start).lerp(end,.5);o.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(V(0,1,0),vec.normalize());
}
const pen=group(left,'writing pencil');
pen.position.copy(left.worldToLocal(V(-1.57,.23,1.62)));pen.rotation.y=-left.rotation.y;
rod(pen,'graphite',[.20,-.014,.095],[.142,.058,.05],.005,.03,ink);
rod(pen,'silver barrel',[.142,.058,.05],[-.37,.73,-.31],.032,.036,metal);
rod(pen,'dark end',[-.37,.73,-.31],[-.417,.791,-.343],.038,.032,ink);
const writingHand=hand(left,'writing hand',[-1.69,.324,1.38],.66,.98,.004);
rod(desk,'spare pen',[-.28,.105,2.93],[1.03,.105,2.55],.033,.035,metal);
rod(desk,'spare pen cap',[.99,.105,2.56],[1.16,.106,2.51],.039,.032,ink);
rod(desk,'foreground pencil',[-2.53,.112,2.43],[-1.94,.11,3.32],.04,.038,ink);
scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xffefd7,0xc29d77,1.28));
function light(name,pos,color,power,shadows){
  const l=new THREE.DirectionalLight(color,power);l.name=name;l.position.set(...pos);scene.add(l);
  if(shadows){
    l.castShadow=true;l.shadow.mapSize.set(1024,1024);
    Object.assign(l.shadow.camera,{left:-5,right:5,top:5,bottom:-5,near:.1,far:23});
    l.shadow.normalBias=.018;l.shadow.bias=-.0003;
  }
}
light('window light',[3.6,6.9,3.7],0xffebcb,2.05,true);
light('soft rear light',[-2.7,5.5,-3],0xffe2ad,1.45,false);

// The upper torso follows the crown at the seam and stays planted at the desk.
const point=new THREE.Vector3(),posed=new THREE.Vector3();
function poseBody(r,dx,dy,dz,pitch,yaw,roll){
  const {head,pivot,body,rest,seam}=r;
  head.rotation.set(pitch,yaw,roll,'YXZ');
  head.position.copy(pivot).add(V(dx,dy,dz));
  const pos=body.geometry.attributes.position;
  for(let i=0;i<pos.count;i++){
    point.fromArray(rest,i*3);
    const w=THREE.MathUtils.smoothstep(point.y,0,seam);
    posed.copy(point).sub(pivot).applyQuaternion(head.quaternion).add(head.position);
    point.lerp(posed,w);pos.setXYZ(i,point.x,point.y,point.z);
  }
  pos.needsUpdate=true;body.geometry.computeVertexNormals();
}
function localOffset(root,x,y,z){
  return V(x,y,z).applyAxisAngle(V(0,1,0),-root.rotation.y);
}
function poseArm(r,dx,dy,dz){
  const delta=localOffset(r.root,dx,dy,dz);
  const pos=r.o.geometry.attributes.position;
  for(let i=0;i<pos.count;i++){
    const w=THREE.MathUtils.smoothstep(Math.floor(i/29)/36,.04,1);
    point.fromArray(r.rest,i*3).addScaledVector(delta,w);
    pos.setXYZ(i,point.x,point.y,point.z);
  }
  pos.needsUpdate=true;r.o.geometry.computeVertexNormals();
}
for(const g of [writingHand,pen,rubbingHand,shoulderHand])g.userData.origin=g.position.clone();
function shift(g,dx,dy,dz){
  g.position.copy(g.userData.origin).add(localOffset(g.parent,dx,dy,dz));
}
const times=[0,200,400,600,800,1000,1200,1400,1500];
const lift=[0,.045,.095,.215,.28,.32,.335,.335,0];
const turn=[0,.02,.07,.63,.95,1,1,1,0];
const handX=[0,-.15,-.38,-.28,-.32,-.38,-.26,-.32,0];
const handY=[0,.034,-.045,.105,.10,.035,.135,.10,0];
const penX=[0,-.14,-.26,-.46,-.55,-.585,-.59,-.59,0];
const penY=[0,.04,.095,.17,.185,.195,.20,.20,0];
const nod=[0,-.035,-.022,-.006,.014,.03,.035,.035,0];
function render(t=0){
  const phase=((t%1500)+1500)%1500;
  let k=0;while(k<7&&phase>=times[k+1])k++;
  const f=(phase-times[k])/(times[k+1]-times[k]);
  const s=f*f*(3-2*f);
  const sample=a=>THREE.MathUtils.lerp(a[k],a[k+1],s);
  const rise=sample(lift),look=sample(turn),bob=sample(nod);
  poseBody(rigs[0],-.13*look,rise,-.04*look,-.225*look,.61*look,.025*look);
  const mouth=rigs[0].mouth;
  mouth.children[0].scale.y=1-.76*look;
  mouth.children[1].scale.y=.046*Math.max(.001,look);
  mouth.children[1].visible=look>.005;
  poseBody(rigs[1],-.035*Math.sin(Math.PI*phase/1500)**2,bob,0,-bob*.25,-.035*look,.012*look);
  const hx=sample(handX),hy=sample(handY),hz=.06*(-hx/.38);
  shift(rubbingHand,hx,hy,hz);poseArm(reaching,hx,hy,hz);
  rubbingHand.rotation.set(0,-right.rotation.y,-1.30+.09*(hy/.14),'YXZ');
  const px=sample(penX),py=sample(penY);
  shift(writingHand,px,py,-.065*look);poseArm(writingArm,px,py,-.065*look);
  shift(pen,px,py,-.065*look);
  pen.rotation.set(0,-left.rotation.y,.31*look,'YXZ');
  shift(shoulderHand,-.07*look,.10*look,0);poseArm(farArm,-.07*look,.10*look,0);
  renderer.render(scene,ref);
}
render(0);
window.nwb={scene,renderer,cameras:{ref},characters,render,ready:true};
</script>
</body>
</html>
